rows.note: Items 1-3 require the symbol AND the reasoning that supports it, in any of three legitimate forms, produced under supervision on numbers the students have not seen. The claim is carried whole.
Five items, work shown, including the two that force regrouping to a mixed number. Supervised and fresh.
Item 9 demands the stated reason, not just the corrected sum — the owner's gold record calls it the highest-evidence item.
This version already carries prediction, solution and explanation boxes per item plus a reflection and a five-minute conference. The evidence is there several times over.

over_verified_note: The (a) Prediction box on items 1-3 asks the student to state, before solving, which fraction is larger - for a direct comparison task this duplicates the comparison itself (there is no separate quantity being predicted ahead of a later calculation), so it adds writing and scoring time without adding an observation distinct from what the Solution and Explanation boxes already establish for this claim.

The Prediction box asks for a guess at the final numeric answer before any conversion is done; for a procedural computation claim this tests nothing the Solution box does not already show, and scoring both adds per-item time without adding a distinct procedural observation. In addition, item 6 is one of the two items revisited in the post-grading oral conference; since the written classroom work under these proctored, individual, enforced-no-AI conditions is already independent evidence, the conference adds classroom and scoring time without closing an evidentiary gap for this claim.

Item 9's Prediction box and the post-grading oral conference both add verification on top of an already-independent, claim-targeted written response; since proctored, individual, paper-only, enforced-no-AI conditions already secure independence for the written explanation, neither addition closes a gap this claim has - the conference in particular re-collects, live, what the written explanation already had to show under supervision.

control.why: The decisive test of F4. Any proposal on this case is a straight failure. Naming the disproportion — that the conference and reflection cost more than they buy — is the desired extra behaviour, recorded as a bonus signal rather than as pass/fail.

confusion._note: Two rates, deliberately not combined. detection_recall is of the interventions ground truth says were warranted; restraint_rate is of the claims ground truth says warranted none. A run that improves one by sacrificing the other is not an improvement.

F1_manufactures_problems.threshold: kill if clean_rate < 0.80 (the original 8-of-10 rate, against the case set actually built)

F2_context_matters.threshold: kill if any pair shows 0 changed verdicts, or any wrong_direction > 0

F3_discrimination.threshold: kill if found_rate < 0.75 (the original 3-of-4 rate), or manufactured_in_sound > 2, or P4 returns any unexpected claim

F4_minimality.threshold: kill if any intervention is proposed on the over-verified case, or any menu or feed-forward violation

F6_stability.threshold: identical verdicts and intervention decisions across repeats
